title: Do you prefer shopping online or in person ?
text:
# Part 1 
I strongly prefer shopping online rather than in person, and there are several reasons to support my opinion.

# Part 2
First of all, online shopping usually offers more convenience./
If I shop online, I can browse and buy products anytime and anywhere without leaving my home./ For example, I often order daily necessities on my phone during my commute/, which saves me the trouble of going to a crowded supermarket.

# Part 3 
Secondly, online shopping usually helps me save time and money.
Instead of walking from store to store, I can easily compare prices with just a few clicks and read customer reviews before making a decision.
Furthermore, online platforms frequently provide special discount.

# Part 4
That’s why I strongly believe shopping online is a better choice.
